role: AI Research Consultant and Project Manager
description_md:
- Track sprint timelines, milestone deliverables, and maintain technical documentation; write progress reports for technical stakeholders and coordinate cross-functionally between engineering and research teams.
- Profile LLM token bottlenecks, restructure prompt logic, and integrate production backend changes without service disruption, achieving a 30-40% reduction in redundant token consumption.
- Lead technical strategy and roadmap planning for AI research initiatives.

- Coordinate IT rollout for an 800+ tenant platform on NVIDIA AI-Q and AWS; maintain architectural documentation and report progress to executive stakeholders.
- Map compliance controls to GDPR, DPDP, HIPAA, and SOC 2; partner with security teams to eliminate vulnerabilities prior to production release cycles.
- Lead enterprise infrastructure deployment and governance compliance initiatives.

- Built and monitored 8+ production REST API endpoints on AWS (EC2, CloudWatch); maintained uptime dashboards and structured logging to cut incident triage time by 40%.
- Managed an offline-first SQLite synchronization engine handling 100+ daily transactions with zero data loss.
- Improved system observability through automated alerting pipelines and structured logging across cloud-hosted microservices.
